items.title: Game Recap: Bobcats Take No. 20 Boise State to the Wire but Fall, 46-45
items.summary: BOISE, Idaho (AP) -- Max Cutforth threw three touchdown passes in the final seven minutes in relief of injured starter Maddux Madsen, and No. 20 Boise State rallied to beat Texas State 46-45 on Saturday night after blowing a 25-point halftime lead.

items.title: Jenkins Named Pac-12 Special Teams Player of the Week
items.summary: SAN MARCOS, Texas – Texas State football's Jaylen Jenkins was named Pac-12 Special Teams Player of the Week after returning a kickoff 100 yards for a touchdown in the Bobcats' 20-17 win over Utah State.

items.title: Game Recap: Bobcats Defeat Utah State, 20-17, in Front of Homecoming Crowd
items.summary: SAN MARCOS, Texas (AP) — Jacob Bonilla's 37-yard field goal with less than two minutes remaining lifted Texas State to a 20-17 victory over Utah State on Saturday night.

items.title: Jackson, Burgess Jr. Pick Up National Recognition
items.summary: SAN MARCOS, Texas – Texas State student-athletes Brad Jackson and Torrance Burgess Jr. gained national attention this week for their performances in the Bobcats' 66-27 win over Colorado State on October 15.

items.title: TXST Lands Four on Dave Campbell’s Mid-Season All-Texas Teams
items.summary: LEWISVILLE, Texas – Texas State football had four student-athletes featured on Dave Campbell's Mid-Season All-Texas Teams, highlighted by running back Torrance Burgess Jr. earning first team honors. Wide receiver Chris Dawn Jr., offensive lineman William Boone and defensive lineman Tymere Jackson were named to the second team.

items.title: Torrance Burgess Jr. Named Pac-12 Offensive Player of the Week
items.summary: SAN RAMON, California – Texas State football's Torrance Burgess Jr. has been named the Pac-12 Conference Offensive Player of the Week following a record-setting performance in the Bobcats' 66-27 victory over Colorado State.
